build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized step heights, jar scale, and angle for two-ball puzzles
add_scene_objects: create static bars, dynamic bars, balls, and jars in the PHYRE scene using C.add()
update_task_relationships: set the TOUCHING spatial relationship between two balls using C.update_task()
set_solution_tier: mark the task as a TWO_BALLS solution tier using C.set_meta()
skip_invalid_params: raise SkipTemplateParams when jar scale and step diff combinations are invalid
